critical.finding: Node config ngm-integ-castai pins kubeletConfig.maxPods=55 statically, overriding the EKS ENI formula (58 on xlarge/2xlarge, 234 on 4xlarge). On the burst-day mix (29x 4xlarge of 78 nodes, 2026-10-02) 4xl nodes run at 24% of their formula pod density; raising template maxCpu beyond 16 (8xl+) would repeat the same density cliff.
critical.action: Remove the static maxPods=55 override (or align it per instance class; consider prefix delegation) before raising node-template maxCpu; reload the node configuration and roll nodes.

high.finding: 16 zone-pinned-PVC StatefulSet pods (scada-dp-server x9, valkey-cluster x6, postgres-dev x1, tileserver x1 in it-292442-*) repeatedly fail rebalancing plans (8 failed plans on 2026-10-01: upscalingFailed, PVC bound to a single AZ / terminating). Consolidation for these nodes is fully blocked; 1 further node is removal-disabled.
high.action: Pin scada-dp-server/valkey workloads to a dedicated node template scoped to their PVC zone (or adopt a topology-aware storage policy), or exclude them from rebalancing; confirm the removal-disabled annotation on ip-10-46-249-239 is intentional.

high.finding: 94.6% of requested CPU is wasted: 292.3 of 309.1 requested cores unused across 313 workloads. Largest offenders: enrich-analog-reindexation-cron (~55.7 cores req, 0 used) and enrich-analog-reset-offset-cron (~34.3 cores req, 0 used) across it-287129-*/it-286247-* etc. WOOP is READ_ONLY/metrics-only on all 313 workloads; workload-autoscaler v1.10.4 is behind latest v1.14.1.
high.action: Move WOOP from READ_ONLY to apply (one-by-one rollout) for the zero-use CronJobs, or right-size their requests manually; upgrade the workload-autoscaler agent to v1.14.1.

high.finding: INFO: live pod-phase scan not possible - no kubectl in this run (AWS creds expired); pod table left empty rather than fabricated. API-verified signals are clean: unscheduled-pods=0 and problematic-nodes=0 (2026-10-04 deep audit), 152 workloads healthy in WOOP snapshot.

high.finding: Cluster runs self-managed cluster-autoscaler eviction: policies report evictor allowed=false, status=Incompatible (aggressiveMode=false, cycle 1m); consolidation proceeds only via rebalancing schedules (hourly + post-scale 05:00 cron). 18 nodeDrained evictions recorded in the 2026-10-02 audit window.
high.action: Keep scheduled rebalancing as the consolidation path (working: 41/50 recent plans finished); no evictor change required unless switching to Cast-managed eviction.

medium.action: When enabling spot, switch the prediction type to the current 'cast-replacement-schedule' model and keep spotBackups enabled.

medium.finding: Burst test cluster (30d node range 44 -> 1,019, daily scale-down to ~601) is 100% on-demand with spot disabled on the single template.
medium.action: Evaluate enabling spot (with spot fallbacks) on default-by-castai for the daily burst window; burst, fault-tolerant integ workloads are a strong spot fit.
